candidates.change_summary: Replace body of withdrawAll to send entire balance to a hardcoded non-owner address instead of calling withdraw(), changing who receives Ether.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove the require), permitting anyone to call withdrawAll and thus altering withdrawAll observable behavior.
Replace call to withdraw with direct transfer to msg.sender instead of calling withdraw(), which alters behavior if withdraw is overridden or future changes exist.
Replaced transfer with call to send value, which forwards all gas and returns success bool; revert on failure was removed (so failed call won't revert), changing post-withdraw balance observable.
Changed require condition to allow anyone except the original owner to call (negated owner check), altering who can call withdraw and thus changing observable withdraw behavior.

Change the low-level call to use send instead of call, which will forward 2300 gas and return a bool; this alters whether the call succeeds and thus can change depositsCount observed after sendMoney (through call effects on target).
Remove the revert on call failure so sendMoney no longer reverts on a failed call; this changes observable state when target call fails (it will allow completion instead of revert).
Remove the require guard so sendMoney (and other owner functions) become callable by anyone, changing observable behavior after sendMoney is called by non-owner accounts.
